TOADAL FEAST · GUEST JOURNEY

BROWSER-LOCAL PREVIEW

Your Feast Pass

A small record of your website journey. Any progress belongs to this browser and device only; there is no account, backend, or cross-device sync.

Starter XP, Sparks, and rewards are editable website configuration, not permanent economy decisions. Treats are the three existing Home discovery candies. All starter progress and rewards stay in this browser and do not transfer to the mobile game. Site previews and visits are not published lore.
